arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.rtype,
    COUNT(*) AS sat_rows,
    COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS matched_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(s.NumTstTakr) = 'integer' AND s.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_integer_denominators,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(s.NumGE1500) = 'integer' THEN 1 END) AS integer_numerators,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(s.NumGE1500) NOT IN ('integer', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS other_numerator_types,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") NOT IN ('real', 'integer', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS other_rate_types,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" -
        f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 0.000000001 THEN 1 END) AS rate_disagreements
FROM main.satscores AS s
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY s.rtype
